notes: Massachusetts Science and Technology/Engineering Curriculum Framework (2016, revised 2020). Complete PK-12 framework based on Framework for K-12 Science Education (NRC, 2012). Similar to NGSS but with Massachusetts-specific additions including more emphasis on technology/engineering and grade-by-grade standards for elementary.
special_features: Includes more technology/engineering content than NGSS, grade-by-grade elementary standards, applications of science in engineering contexts
